ai_exposure.description: Current fraction of total company revenue directly attributable to AI-factory infrastructure. Abstain unless the document provides enough segment or product revenue data to calculate it.

ai_segment_cagr_bear.description: Three-year bear-case CAGR for the company's AI-factory-exposed business, expressed as a decimal. It must be traceable to disclosed demand, guidance or backlog and is always review-required.

ai_segment_cagr_base.description: Three-year base-case CAGR for the company's AI-factory-exposed business, expressed as a decimal and supported by disclosed drivers.

ai_segment_cagr_bull.description: Three-year bull-case CAGR for the company's AI-factory-exposed business, expressed as a decimal and supported by disclosed upside drivers.

moat_architectural_lock_in.description: 0-5 score for proprietary architecture or software-platform lock-in. 0 means none; 5 means a dominant proprietary platform with material dependency.

moat_switching_costs.description: 0-5 score for technical, operational or qualification switching costs; 5 requires strong documented customer dependency.

moat_standards_and_ip.description: 0-5 score for defensible intellectual property or standards-setting influence.

moat_ecosystem_and_design_wins.description: 0-5 score for ecosystem reach, reference architectures and durable design wins.

moat_bottleneck_scarcity.description: 0-5 score for control of a scarce production capability or supply-chain bottleneck.

moat_competitive_intensity.description: 0-5 score where 5 means favorable competitive structure and 0 means intense commoditized competition.

risk_customer_concentration.description: 0-5 customer-concentration risk severity; 5 is extreme concentration.

risk_execution.description: 0-5 product, capacity-ramp, construction or delivery execution risk severity.

risk_geopolitical_regulatory.description: 0-5 export-control, geopolitical and regulatory risk severity.

risk_commoditization.description: 0-5 risk that alternatives, standards or price competition erode differentiation.

role_narrative.description: Concise evidence-backed description of how the company monetizes AI-factory capital spending.

catalyst.description: Evidence-backed demand, product-cycle, capacity or backlog catalyst with a stated time horizon where available.

contrary_evidence.description: Specific evidence that weakens the AI-factory growth thesis or contradicts another claim.
